# Paseo Code

Turn agent coding work into supervised plans, sandboxed execution, review-ready outputs, pull request handoff, and a clean checkout path for teams.

Website: https://paseocode.space/
Pricing: https://paseocode.space/pricing/
Checkout: https://paseocode.space/checkout/
Support: support@aigeamy.com
Type: Hosted SaaS workflow product

Problem:
- Teams need a quotable product definition, pricing path, evidence trail, and checkout route.

Solution:
- Paseo Code provides a hosted workflow with public pricing, structured evidence, support contact, and report or receipt outputs.

- Home: https://paseocode.space/
